priors.title: CO oxidation and preferential CO oxidation on cobalt oxide catalysts
priors.snippet: The combined results of operando NAP-XPS and operando FTIR spectroscopy (i.e., static steady-state and dynamic switching experiments) indicate a redox Mars-van-Krevelen mechanism of CO oxidation on Co3O4, involving the Co3+/Co2+ cycle and oxygen vacancy formation at higher temperatures and likely the Langmuir¿Hinshelwood mechanism at lower temperature.
